title: LinkResponse
description: Response emitted by `sqlite-graphrag link` on stdout as JSON. CLI accepts `--from-id`/`--to-id` (v1.1.05) for ID-based endpoints, but the output envelope still reports entity names in `from`/`to` after resolution.

from.description: Source entity name (resolved; never a raw numeric ID even when linked via `--from-id`).

to.description: Target entity name (resolved; never a raw numeric ID even when linked via `--to-id`).

created_entities.description: Entity names auto-created by --create-missing. Omitted when empty.

warnings.description: Non-canonical relation warnings (empty array when relation is canonical)
